notes:
Settings > General now lets you create a password-encrypted .streammate backup of providers, favorites, followed teams, interests and portable preferences. Restore previews the contents and preserves existing provider logins. Keep the backup password somewhere safe; it cannot be recovered. Android TV file transfers require a compatible document picker.

Optionally add your own TMDB API key during onboarding or in Settings > Providers for additional movie and show artwork. The key stays on the device and is excluded from portable backups. IPTV and the guide work without it.
